description: Trigger-discoverability subset of evals.json. The skill should select on every must_trigger prompt and NOT on any must_not_trigger prompt.

must_trigger.prompt: Can you check whether this workstation is ready for Isaac Sim installation?
Before I run Isaac Sim in Docker, verify the NVIDIA Container Toolkit setup.
I need to install an older Isaac Sim build from this public zip URL and MD5.

must_not_trigger.prompt: Launch Isaac Sim headless in Docker for WebRTC streaming.

Check if my Isaac Sim Python venv works.

Build the Isaac Sim ROS 2 workspace for Humble.
